When people think about bulimics, the idea of “someone who eats and then pukes it up” comes to mind. Bulimia is binge eating followed by purging, and the way to ensure the calories you ate go undigested is to vomit them right up. This is definitely true.

The thing people who don’t have an eating disorder don’t realize is that purging isn’t necessarily ridding oneself of food one just ate, but forms of food and calories. The other ways to purge are using/abusing laxatives as well as over-exercising. I used to think my exercise regimen of 17 sessions a week was being “dedicated”. Now I know it was a symptom of my ED.
